description: Source code for a Bluetooth Health Thermometer Service (HTS) sample implementation using Zephyr RTOS, including service declaration, temperature measurement simulation, and indication handling.

methods.name: htmc_ccc_cfg_changed
methods.description: Callback for configuration changes on the CCC descriptor, toggles temperature indication simulation.

methods.name: indicate_cb
methods.description: Callback invoked upon completion of a GATT indication, logs success or failure.

methods.name: indicate_destroy
methods.description: Callback invoked when an indication is destroyed, resets the indicating flag.

methods.name: hts_init
methods.description: Initializes the temperature device, checks if device is ready, and logs status.

methods.name: hts_indicate
methods.description: Simulates temperature measurement and sends GATT indications if enabled.
